scripts.build:firebase: node scripts/prepare-prod-schema.mjs && prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && next build
scripts.db:seed:prod: node scripts/prepare-prod-schema.mjs && prisma generate && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: rm -f prisma/dev.db && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
